title: Androgen Metabolism and Reproductive Outcome
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to determine maternal androgen metabolism during pregnancy and the impact of androgen disorders on mothers and infants.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* pregnant women with and without PCOS

Exclusion Criteria:

* unable to consent
study_population: Polycystic ovary Syndrome (PCOS): According to ethnicity and the criteria used for diagnosis, polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) affects between 2-13% of women of reproductive age (Asunción et al., 2000; Azziz et al., 2009; ESHRE/ASRM, 2004; Wang and Alvero, 2013).
